notes.title: Regeneration at Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce that the demo version of [b]Regeneration[/b] is now accessible to all players as part of the Steam Next Fest! Dive into the prologue to experience the gripping storyline and explore the core mechanics that define the game. Most importantly, immerse yourself in the haunting atmosphere that the game world offers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217231/3aea329164cf66f8fbfb2f0d1bbcc216f16a3c75.jpg[/img]

Developed over several years under challenging conditions, [b]Regeneration[/b] is a testament to the dedication and passion of the team at [b]Misterial Games[/b]. Despite limited resources, our studio has continually advanced the project. Now, the future of the game heavily relies on the support and enthusiasm of players like you.

We eagerly invite you to download the demo and [b]share your thoughts[/b] in the Steam community. Your [b]feedback[/b] is invaluable to us and will play a crucial role in shaping the game's development.

Thank you for being a part of this journey.
